item.name: 11. Auto News Agent v4 (24/7 Autopilot)
item.description: ⚡ Auto News Agent v4: Full 24/7 background autopilot system that discovers listing news from 19+ top media sources (Prothom Alo, Daily Amar Desh, Daily Ittefaq, Naya Diganta, etc.), rewrites them using Google Gemini AI, removes watermarks/newspaper branding, and publishes them automatically with category mapping.

Fetches the current settings (interval, postsPerRun, scanPerSource, defaultPostStatus, Gemini API key, preferredModel, extraInstruction, aiRewrite toggle, ticker toggle, crop/resize, watermark settings).
